study.citation: Kryeziu et al., Cell Reports Medicine 2026

primary_panel.selection_rule: all harmonized drugs with complete DSS across the two libraries; selected from coverage only before model outcomes

expression.secondary_transform: public processed GEO series-matrix values, then patient mean
expression.secondary_caveat: GEO values use the authors' fixed public array preprocessing and are secondary, not a second confirmatory family
expression.feature_norm: divide standardized features by sqrt(number retained)

model.primary: multioutput linear-kernel Ridge on training-centered drug-specific DSS residuals
model.inner_cv: deterministic 5-fold patient split within each outer-training set

nulls.baseline_rna_shuffle: permute outer-training molecular rows; use observed outer-training-only selected alpha
nulls.patient_response_profile_shuffle: permute complete outer-training drug profiles; use observed outer-training-only selected alpha

inference.simultaneous_method: studentized maximum-deviation patient bootstrap lower bounds

claim_boundary: ex vivo functional drug sensitivity only; not clinical efficacy or treatment recommendation
